microStakeSkeleton: A delivery person is at the front entrance of the minshuku with a package. They need to confirm the recipient's name, ask whether you can sign on behalf of the host family, and clarify a delivery instruction. They speak in keigo throughout — your chance to handle a real formal exchange.
allowedNudges: If the player struggles, the delivery person rephrases politely with a slightly simpler keigo construction.
The delivery person may step back, give the player a moment, then re-ask the same question more clearly.
exitBeat: The delivery person bows, thanks you, and heads back to the truck.
